// Generated by fizzyx. Do not edit.

import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card"

function displayValue(value: unknown): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") return "—"
  if (typeof value === "object") return JSON.stringify(value, null, 2)
  return String(value)
}

export function RecordDetails({ data }: { data: unknown }) {
  const entries = data && typeof data === "object" && !Array.isArray(data) ? Object.entries(data as Record<string, unknown>) : []
  return <Card>
    <CardHeader className="border-b"><CardTitle>Record Information</CardTitle><CardDescription>Values returned by the API for this record.</CardDescription></CardHeader>
    <CardContent className="p-0">
      {entries.length ? <dl className="divide-y">{entries.map(([key, value]) => <div className="grid gap-2 px-5 py-4 sm:grid-cols-[minmax(140px,0.35fr)_1fr]" key={key}><dt className="text-sm font-medium capitalize text-muted-foreground">{key.replaceAll("_", " ")}</dt><dd className="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words font-mono text-sm text-foreground">{displayValue(value)}</dd></div>)}</dl> : <p className="px-5 py-12 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">No record details are available.</p>}
    </CardContent>
  </Card>
}
